reason: A named independent lab and a batch report I can check against the number on the box is exactly what I look for before buying. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one, mostly because the sachet fixes my habit of leaving vitamins on the counter and forgetting them.
objection: It is made in China and brand new, with no reviews yet. I would open the lab report first and check that the batch number matches. Two capsules a day is also more than I like to swallow.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic, not matching a real batch number, or the lab could not be looked up, I would not buy.
